answer: Liveness is proven by signing a fresh random challenge issued by the network, and the signature must arrive within a short window. A pre-recorded signature fails because the challenge changes every round. An attacker would have to hold the live owner key and answer fresh challenges for every fake identity continuously. Even a quiet basalt gets heard, because recovery weighs proofs, not volume. The shale test catches the lazy fake and the ripple test catches the patient one.
